newsitem.title: USA: Donnkenny gets extended bank credit.
newsitem.headline: Donnkenny gets extended bank credit.

text.p: Donnkenny, Inc said Friday its senior lenders, The Chase Manhattan Corp, Bank of New York Co Inc and Fleet Bank N.A., agreed to extend the term of the parties' previously announced waiver agreement from February 27, 1997, until April 30, 1997.

The new arrangements, which continue a waiver of certain defaults under Donnkenny's credit agreement, also increase the company's credit availability to $70 million and continues a term loan of $17.5 million.
The company said that this would be sufficient to meet its business needs for the term of the new agreement, enabling it to stabilize day-to-day operations and restore its financial credibility.

In a separate statement Donkenny said that it had agreed with the former owner of Fashion Avenue Knits and related companies to rescind the previously announced acquisition of these businesses, saying that it intended to focus on its core businesses.
